enriched_activities.activity: Lying in bed watching YouTube videos on phone and journaling before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Unlock the phone with the thumb. Tap the YouTube app icon. Scroll the video list with the thumb. Tap a video to play it. Hold the phone above the face. Tap the screen to pause the video. Put the phone down on the mattress. Pick up the pen from the nightstand. Open the journal to the next blank page. Write several lines with the pen. Turn the page. Write several more lines. Put the pen down on the nightstand. Pick up the phone again. Resume the video. Scroll to another video. Tap to play. Lower the phone onto the chest. Tap the screen to stop playback. Place the phone on the nightstand. Close the journal and set it aside.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Place the phone face down on the nightstand. Reach to the lamp switch. Press the switch to turn off the light. Pull the blanket up over the shoulders. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Remain lying with eyes closed. Turn onto the back. Pull the blanket up. Turn onto the left side. Push the pillow with the hand. Remain lying. Roll onto the back again. Stretch the left arm out. Pull the arm back under the blanket. Turn onto the right side. Remain lying. Kick the blanket down with the foot. Pull the blanket back up with the hand. Remain lying until the alarm sounds.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering with hot water, washing up and grooming
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Turn on the light switch. Turn the water heater switch on. Open the shower door. Turn the shower tap to hot. Step into the shower. Stand under the water. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms, chest and legs. Rinse off the soap. Turn the tap off. Step out of the shower. Take the towel from the hook. Rub the hair with the towel. Wipe the arms, chest and legs. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water from the tap. Spit into the sink. Wipe the face with the towel. Pick up the comb. Comb the hair. Put the comb down. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a breakfast that fits the medical dietary restriction and brewing strong coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the eggs and vegetables. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the cupboard. Take out a pan and a plate. Close the cupboard. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Crack two eggs into the pan. Turn the eggs with a spatula. Switch off the cooker. Slide the eggs onto the plate. Slice the vegetables on the cutting board. Put the vegetables on the plate. Fill the kettle with water. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch. Take a mug from the cupboard. Spoon coffee grounds into the mug. Pour the boiled water into the mug. Stir with a spoon. Carry the plate and mug to the table. Sit down. Eat the eggs and vegetables with a fork. Drink the coffee. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Rinse them under the tap. Place them in the drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Daily stretching followed by prayer and devotional reflection
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Roll out the yoga mat on the floor. Stand on the mat with feet apart. Raise both arms overhead. Bend forward and touch the toes. Hold the position. Straighten up. Place hands on the hips. Twist the torso to the left. Twist the torso to the right. Sit down on the mat. Extend the legs forward. Reach the hands toward the feet. Hold. Lie back on the mat. Pull the knees to the chest. Roll to a sitting position. Stand up. Roll up the mat. Place the mat in the corner. Pick up the prayer book from the nightstand. Sit on the edge of the bed. Open the book. Read the passage aloud. Close the book. Place it on the nightstand. Fold the hands together. Bow the head. Recite the prayer. Lift the head. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up desk lamp, computer and monitor, opening client notes for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the study. Pull the chair out from the desk. Sit down on the chair. Press the desk lamp switch. Press the monitor power button. Press the computer power button. Move the mouse to wake the screen. Type the login password on the keyboard. Press Enter. Open the client notes folder with the mouse. Double-click the first client file. Scroll through the notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Conducting telehealth clinical psychology consultations and taking session notes
enriched_activities.desc: Open the video call app on the computer. Click the client's name in the contact list. Click the call button. Adjust the monitor angle with the hand. Put on the headset. Greet the client: 'Good morning, how are you today?' Listen to the client. Nod the head. Write notes on the notepad with the pen. Ask the client a follow-up question. Type notes into the client file on the keyboard. Scroll through the previous session notes. Continue the conversation. End the call by clicking the end button. Save the notes with Ctrl+S. Open the next client file. Click the call button for the second client. Repeat the greeting. Take handwritten notes on the pad. Type the summary into the file. Save the file. Stand up during the break between sessions. Sit back down. Open the third client file. Start the third call. Listen and write notes. End the call. Save the file. Close the laptop-lid halfway. Stand up from the chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a lunch that respects the dietary restriction
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the chicken and vegetables. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the knife from the drawer. Cut the chicken on the cutting board. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Add the chicken to the pan. Stir with the spatula. Add the vegetables. Pour sauce over the food. Stir again. Press the power button off. Slide the food onto a plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit down on the chair. Eat with a fork and knife. Drink water from the glass. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Rinse the plate under the tap. Place the plate in the dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Drive the EV to a local shop, buy groceries with cash, and drive the EV back
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the car key from the hook. Walk out of the house. Open the driver door of the EV. Sit in the driver seat. Fasten the seat belt. Press the start button. Shift the gear to drive. Press the accelerator pedal. Steer the wheel onto the road. Drive to the local shop. Park the EV in the parking lot. Press the power button off. Unfasten the seat belt. Open the door. Step out. Close the door. Walk into the shop. Pick up a basket. Take vegetables from the shelf. Place them in the basket. Take milk from the refrigerator shelf. Add it to the basket. Walk to the checkout counter. Place the basket on the counter. Take cash from the wallet. Hand the cash to the cashier. Take the change and receipt. Put the change in the wallet. Pick up the grocery bags. Walk to the EV. Open the trunk. Place the bags in the trunk. Close the trunk. Open the driver door. Sit down. Fasten the seat belt. Press the start button. Shift to drive. Drive back home. Park the EV. Press the power button off. Unfasten the seat belt. Open the door. Step out. Open the trunk. Pick up the grocery bags. Close the trunk. Walk into the house. Close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing telehealth consultations and writing up clinical documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the study. Pull the chair out. Sit down. Press the monitor power button. Open the laptop lid. Type the login password. Open the next client file with the mouse. Click the call button. Greet the client: 'Hello, thank you for joining.' Listen and nod. Write on the notepad with the pen. Type notes into the file. Scroll the previous notes. Ask a follow-up question. End the call. Save the file. Stand up and stretch the arms. Sit down again. Open the next client file. Start the call. Take notes on the pad. Type the summary. End the call. Save the file. Open the documentation template. Type a clinical report on the keyboard. Proofread the report on the screen. Correct two sentences with the keyboard. Save the report. Close the client files. Turn the monitor off. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Daily stretching and quiet decompression after the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Roll out the yoga mat on the floor. Stand on the mat. Raise the arms overhead. Bend forward to touch the toes. Hold the stretch. Straighten the body. Place the hands on the hips. Twist the torso left. Twist the torso right. Sit on the mat. Extend the legs. Reach the hands toward the feet. Lie back. Pull the knees to the chest. Roll to a sitting position. Stand up. Roll up the mat. Place the mat in the corner. Sit down on the sofa. Lean the head back on the cushion. Close the eyes. Breathe in and out slowly. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner from scratch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the fish, rice and vegetables. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the cupboard. Take out the rice cooker pot. Close the cupboard. Measure rice into the pot with a cup. Rinse the rice under the tap. Pour water into the pot. Place the pot into the rice cooker. Press the cook button. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Cut the fish into pieces. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Add the fish. Turn the fish with the spatula. Add the vegetables. Pour sauce into the pan. Stir the food. Press the power button off. Take plates from the cupboard. Slide the food onto the plates. Place the plates on the table. Place chopsticks and forks beside the plates.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the table with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Pull two chairs out from the table. Sit down on one chair. Wait for Member 1. Greet Member 1: 'Hi, how was your day?' Pick up the fork. Take food from the plate. Eat the fish and vegetables. Drink water from the glass. Talk to Member 1: 'Could you pass the water?' Take the water jug from Member 1. Pour water into the glass. Put the jug down. Continue eating with the fork. Take a piece of fish. Eat the rice with the chopsticks. Put the chopsticks down. Drink the water. Wipe the mouth with the napkin. Push the plate slightly forward. Stand up from the chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, loading the dishwasher and tidying the kitchen surfaces with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the plates from the table. Carry the plates to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plates under the water. Hand the plates to Member 1. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Place the plates in the rack. Push the rack in. Pick up the glasses from the table. Carry them to the sink. Rinse the glasses. Place the glasses in the dishwasher rack. Take the cooking pan. Scrub the pan with a sponge. Rinse the pan. Place the pan in the dishwasher. Sprinkle soap into the dishwasher dispenser. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the counter surfaces with the cloth. Wipe the table. Wring the cloth over the sink. Hang the cloth on the hook. Pick up the food scraps. Throw them into the bin. Close the bin lid.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching a streaming series on the TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote from the table. Press the power button. Press the streaming app button. Scroll the series list with the arrow keys. Press the select button on the chosen series. Press play. Place the remote on the sofa armrest. Lean back on the cushion. Watch the screen. Pick up the remote. Press pause. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take a bottle of water. Close the refrigerator door. Walk back to the living room. Sit on the sofa. Open the bottle. Drink water. Close the bottle. Put it on the table. Press play on the remote. Continue watching. Press the volume-down button. Watch the next episode. Press pause. Place the remote on the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Turn the head toward the living room door as Member 1 enters. Say to Member 1: 'Come sit, the episode is playing.' Pick up the remote. Press play. Turn the screen slightly toward Member 1. Point at the screen and say: 'This is the part I told you about.' Lean back on the cushion. Watch the screen. Press the volume-down button. Place the remote on the table. Watch the screen with Member 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the living room and vacuuming the floor with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the sofa. Press the TV power button on the remote. Pick up the glasses from the table. Carry them to the kitchen. Place the glasses on the counter. Walk back to the living room. Pick up the cushions from the floor. Place the cushions on the sofa. Fold the blanket with both hands. Place the blanket on the sofa armrest. Open the closet door. Take out the vacuum cleaner. Close the closet door. Plug the cord into the socket. Press the power button. Push the vacuum over the floor. Move the vacuum around the sofa. Vacuum under the table. Pull the vacuum back. Press the power button off. Unplug the cord. Wrap the cord around the handle. Open the closet door. Place the vacuum inside. Close the closet door. Straighten the rug with the foot.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading a book on clinical practice and reviewing continuing education materials
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the study. Pull the chair out. Sit down. Press the desk lamp switch. Pick up the book from the desk. Open the book to the bookmark. Read the page. Turn the page with the right hand. Write a note in the margin with the pen. Turn another page. Continue reading. Close the book. Place it on the desk. Open the laptop lid. Type the password. Open the browser. Open the continuing education module. Scroll the module page with the mouse. Read the text on the screen. Click the next page button. Read further. Click the quiz link. Answer the first question with the mouse. Answer the second question. Click submit. Read the result on the screen. Close the browser. Close the laptop lid. Turn the desk lamp off. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash, skincare and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the light switch. Turn on the tap. Wet the hands under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap between the hands. Wash the face with the hands. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the hook. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the cleanser bottle. Squeeze cleanser onto the fingers. Apply the cleanser to the face. Rinse with water from the tap. Turn off the tap. Pick up the moisturizer jar. Open the lid. Take cream with the fingers. Apply the cream to the face. Close the lid. Put the jar on the shelf. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth. Spit into the sink. Put the toothbrush in the holder. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Listening to music and journaling while checking WhatsApp messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Press the light switch on. Sit down on the bed. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Unlock the phone. Open the music app. Tap a playlist. Place the phone on the nightstand with the speaker up. Pick up the journal from the nightstand. Open it to the next page. Pick up the pen. Write several lines. Put the pen down. Pick up the phone. Open WhatsApp. Read the incoming messages. Type a reply with both thumbs. Press send. Read another message. Type a reply. Press send. Place the phone on the bed. Pick up the pen. Write several more lines in the journal. Close the journal. Place it on the nightstand. Pick up the phone. Open the music app. Tap the next track. Place the phone on the nightstand.

enriched_activities.activity: Dimming the light, praying and winding down before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the bed. Walk to the lamp. Press the switch to dim the light. Walk to the door. Press the main light switch off. Walk back to the bed. Pull the blanket down. Sit on the edge of the bed. Fold the hands together. Bow the head. Recite the prayer. Lift the head. Pick up the prayer book from the nightstand. Open it. Read a passage. Close the book. Place it on the nightstand. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up over the chest. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Place the phone face down on the nightstand. Close the eyes. Remain lying.
